messages:
alex: Quick design check: I'm exploring multiplex+hedge where we combine similar inbound read requests into one upstream call and fan responses back. Main question: how do we keep side-effect safety and resume semantics for streaming?

jia: If you coalesce, you need to either propagate per-subrequest tokens or restrict coalescing to read-only endpoints. Otherwise duplicates can cause side-effects.

matt: Propagating per-subrequest metadata (e.g., X-Sub-Id, X-Idempotency) works but increases header churn and tracing complexity. Could gate it behind a config flag per route.

irene: For streaming resumes we also need a consistent checkpoint per logical request (kv-cache offset or token index). Without that clients can't resume cleanly if upstream aborts mid-token.

alex: Proposed minimal pattern:
- Default: coalesce only for read routes (embeddings, search, inference with allow_side_effects=false).
- Opt-in: add X-Sub-Id + X-Resume-Checkpoint headers when teams want coalescing for other workloads. Upstream must echo resume checkpoints per sub-id.

matt: Operational concerns: (1) memory during coalesce windows (holds per-subrequest buffers), (2) billing attribution for merged responses.

jia: Billing: best-effort split by prompt length or require upstream to return per-subrequest token counts. For now do proportional split and add instrumentation.

irene: Failure modes: upstream partial send then abort. With per-sub checkpoints we can return a resume token to each client. Without it we should fail all subrequests to be safe.

alex: Early implementation notes I tried: coalesce_window_ms=10, small in-memory map with eviction for windows > 50ms, and a mem gauge. Saw 12% token cost reduction in synthetic load but mem spiked on 0.8s bursts.

matt: Suggest auto-fallback: if coalesce_mem_gauge > threshold or burst_rate > N, swap to passthrough mode for that route for T seconds. Also only hedge when p95 upstream latency > Xms.

jia: Metrics plan: coalesce_attempts, coalesce_successes, coalesce_mem_bytes, per_sub_failures, per_sub_resume_tokens_issued, coalesced_token_split_bias (histogram).

edge-bot: deploy: edge/proxy/coop-coalesce v0.1 -> succeeded in staging (2025-02-14T15:12:01Z)

irene: Can you add a tiny curl example and a minimal RFC with config knobs+metric names? I want to run load tests.

alex: Curl example for read route: 
curl -X POST https://edge.redwood.ai/v1/merge/embeddings \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"input":"hello world","sub_id":"s1"}'

alex: I'll file the RFC w/ perf table and opt-in header schema. Thanks all for the quick feedback.
